tips: Smelt 1 iron ore with 1 coal in a furnace. code_default starts with coal; otherwise mine coal.
description: Craft 1 iron ingot using 1 iron ore and 1 coal on a furnace as the platform.

tips: 1 furnace is crafted from 8 cobblestone on a crafting table.
description: Craft 1 furnace using 8 cobblestone on a crafting table as the platform.

tips: Mine 1 iron ore with a stone pickaxe.
description: Mine 1 iron ore using a stone pickaxe as the tool.
Craft 1 stone pickaxe using 3 cobblestone and 2 stick on a crafting table as the platform.

tips: Need 3 cobblestone for the stone pickaxe and 8 for the furnace.
description: Mine 11 cobblestone using a wooden pickaxe as the tool.
Craft 1 wooden pickaxe using 3 planks and 2 stick on a crafting table as the platform.

tips: 1 crafting table can be crafted with 4 planks.
